name: reading-challenge-tracker
description: Reading Challenge Tracker for the fictional Lantern Lane Library: Next.js web, Node API with SQLite, Expo mobile.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @rct/api && npm run build -w @rct/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @rct/api" "npm run dev -w @rct/web"
scripts.mobile: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w @rct/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @rct/shared && npm run test -w @rct/api && npm run test -w @rct/web && npm run test -w @rct/mobile
